fields.Appearance: Sun-browned, strong-handed, and dressed in patched clothes carrying the smell of soil.
fields.Backstory: Worked the same rented fields since childhood while watching rents rise after every good harvest.
fields.Goals: Own the farm, protect the household, and organize neighbors against predatory contracts.

fields.Appearance: Lean and weathered, wrapped in wool with a shepherd's crook polished by use.
fields.Backstory: Spent years moving herds through remote highlands and knows paths absent from every map.
fields.Goals: Recover stolen livestock and preserve ancestral grazing rights.

fields.Appearance: Broad-backed with grain dust in their hair and a permanently cautious expression.
fields.Backstory: A mill worker discovered someone has been diluting the village's emergency flour stores.
fields.Goals: Expose the theft without causing panic and ensure the winter supply survives.

fields.Appearance: Young, mud-spattered, and quick-moving, with practical clothes and several homemade tools.
fields.Backstory: A rural laborer taught themselves to repair machinery after the estate stopped paying craftsmen.
fields.Goals: Become a recognized engineer and free the village from dependence on the estate.

fields.Appearance: Older, deeply lined, and steady-eyed, wearing a faded festival ribbon for luck.
fields.Backstory: Survived famine, war, and three landlords while quietly becoming the hamlet's trusted mediator.
fields.Goals: Keep the younger generation from repeating old feuds and secure communal ownership of the well.
